candidate.name: Uniswap
candidate.role: RWA-linked trading infrastructure and fee-burn value-capture leader
candidate.leadership_classification: UNI is the clearest infrastructure/value-capture expression of Robinhood Chain's tokenized-asset growth; PONS remains the native speculative-token leader. This is a regime-quality upgrade, not a PONS-to-UNI leadership handoff.

why_threshold_crossed_now: The newly added RWA-capital methodology reveals that Robinhood Chain's growth is not only meme/launchpad turnover: RWA.xyz now reports distributed asset value of $171.85M, +494.62% over 30 days, with RWA 30-day transfer volume of $10.52B, +545.12%.

RWA holder count reached 1,097,944 (+178.10% over 30 days), while stablecoin market cap reached $951.09M (+62.57%) and 30-day stablecoin transfer volume $50.01B (+114.36%). These identifiable financial-capital metrics receive more weight than raw transactions, gas, or wallet counts.

This is not issuance/AUM alone: tokenized stocks are actively traded through Uniswap on Robinhood Chain. Recent venue data showed approximately $130M in a single day of stock-token trading, more than $1B cumulative by mid-August, and roughly 99% of Robinhood tokenized-stock DEX liquidity on Uniswap, split approximately 73% v4 and 26% v3 at that checkpoint.

Current Token Terminal-derived reporting shows $192.6M of tokenized-stock value deployed across DeFi, with Uniswap v4 at $59.1M and v3 at $20.9M. Robinhood-issued stocks account for about $73.1M of category deposits. These are productive liquidity/deposit figures, not simply minted notional.

Robinhood Chain remains an abnormal speculative regime in parallel: DefiLlama currently shows $1.368B 24h DEX volume, $10.424B over seven days (+95.26% week-over-week), stablecoin market cap $964.58M (+25.36% over seven days), and $908.65M TVL (+5.51% over 24h), despite negative $47.8M 24h net inflow. This supports high capital velocity rather than passive balance growth alone.

UNI passes the value-capture gate because Uniswap protocol fees are converted into permanently burned UNI. Robinhood Chain's v2/v3 fee expansion and v4 fee-controller activation were approved/executed in July 2026; Robinhood activity subsequently contributed roughly 150,000 of the 184,000 UNI burned on Sept. 4, worth about $1.15M total that day.

UNI is approximately $7.00 at the checkpoint, +10.2% over 24h and +34.4% over seven days, with a roughly $4.36B market cap and broad access across 145 exchanges / 332 markets. Price/market confirmation is supportive but receives less weight than RWA utilization and value capture.

rwa_signal.metric_definition_note: RWA transfer volume is not treated as secondary trading volume. Separate Uniswap/tokenized-stock trading data is required to establish real secondary use. RWA.xyz distributed asset value also differs from DefiLlama's current $251.53M RWA Active MCap; the discrepancy is preserved rather than reconciled by assumption.

secondary_trading_and_utilization.utilization_note: Uniswap deposits are primarily liquidity-pool inventory and therefore represent deployed trading liquidity. Other category deposits can represent lending/collateral. The $73.1M figure is issuer-level Robinhood stock exposure across DeFi and is not assumed to equal chain-level Robinhood Chain TVL.

speculative_regime_context.assessment: Robinhood Chain remains the strongest broad speculative-velocity regime, but the RWA/stablecoin evidence upgrades its quality because identifiable financial assets and settlement balances are expanding alongside speculation.
speculative_regime_context.contamination_discount: Gas subsidies, bots/HFT/arbitrage, account abstraction, launchpad incentives and memecoin recycling remain discounts. The RWA signal reduces reliance on those noisy metrics but does not eliminate contamination.

leadership_rotation.native_speculation: PONS remains the native speculative leader; no qualified handoff is declared.
leadership_rotation.infrastructure_value_capture: UNI is upgraded as the clearest RWA-linked infrastructure/value-capture leader because Uniswap dominates Robinhood tokenized-stock liquidity and approved protocol fees route trading economics into UNI burn.
leadership_rotation.prior_competitors: ARB remains a higher-beta Robinhood/Arbitrum narrative expression but its value capture is less direct. PAIR remains an emerging Robinhood platform challenger but has materially shallower executable liquidity and has retraced sharply from today's ATH.

wallet_quality.prior_state: Earlier prospective research had identified a Hayes-linked repeat UNI acquisition plus a separate Nansen-labelled whale/fresh-wallet accumulation cohort. That prior evidence is retained but not double-counted as a new trigger in this observation.
wallet_quality.independence_caveat: Full beneficial-ownership and funding independence across all prior labelled wallets remains unresolved.

value_capture.mechanism: Uniswap protocol fees are collected into onchain fee infrastructure and exchanged for UNI that is permanently burned. Robinhood Chain fee activation includes v2/v3 and selected v4 fee-controller coverage.
value_capture.important_caveat: Not every Uniswap v4 pool is necessarily subject to protocol fees; v4 fee activation applies selected pool families/policies. Therefore tokenized-stock TVL and volume should not be multiplied mechanically by a universal fee rate. UNI holders have no pro-rata revenue claim; value accrual is mediated through supply burn.

structural_gate.sellability: PASS - broad global liquidity across 145 exchanges and 332 markets at the checkpoint
structural_gate.honeypot_or_transfer_restriction: PASS - established ERC-20 with canonical Ethereum contract and no token-level sell restriction
structural_gate.governance_mint_authority: Governance can mint up to 2% of total supply annually but has not exercised this authority to date.
structural_gate.vesting: Team, investor and advisor vesting concluded in September 2025.
structural_gate.liquidity: PASS for practical executability; this is not dependent on one creator-controlled LP.
structural_gate.major_caveat: Governance controls fee parameters and retains limited dilution authority; token value capture is policy-mediated rather than a legally enforceable revenue claim.

organic_basis: RWA.xyz shows exceptional 30-day growth in Robinhood distributed assets and transfer activity
stablecoin balances and settlement transfer volume are simultaneously expanding
stock tokens have demonstrated substantial real secondary DEX trading rather than issuance alone
Uniswap dominates Robinhood stock-token DEX liquidity and has direct fee-to-UNI-burn economics
narrative_and_news.influencer_risk: No new influencer promotion is counted as positive evidence. Current UNI social momentum following the burn record is treated as reflexivity risk rather than an independent confirmation signal.
narrative_and_news.regulatory_risk: Robinhood stock tokens are economic-exposure instruments rather than direct shareholder claims and are unavailable to U.S. users. AMC's CEO has publicly challenged the products and threatened regulatory/legal escalation, creating a material policy risk to the RWA growth path.

major_uncertainties: RWA.xyz distributed asset value ($171.85M) and DefiLlama RWA Active MCap ($251.53M) use different definitions; neither is silently substituted for the other.
RWA transfer volume is not secondary market volume. The alert relies separately on tokenized-stock DEX trading and DeFi deployment data to establish use.
Robinhood-issued stock DeFi deposits of about $73.1M are issuer-level across DeFi, not proven to be entirely resident on Robinhood Chain.
Only selected v4 pool families are subject to current protocol fees, so the exact fraction of tokenized-stock trading that creates UNI burn requires pool-level attribution.
Gas subsidies and speculative meme/stock-pair trading can still inflate Robinhood activity despite the higher-quality RWA evidence.
Robinhood stock tokens face legal/regulatory and issuer-acceptance risk and do not confer direct shareholder rights.
No new independent historically selective wallet cohort was established this run.
why_signal_matters: The new RWA filter changes the quality assessment of the same Robinhood regime. What previously looked primarily like exceptional meme/launchpad velocity now also shows explosive growth in identifiable tokenized financial assets, stablecoin settlement balances and real stock-token secondary trading. Uniswap is the dominant liquidity venue for that activity and its approved protocol fee system converts a portion of trading economics into permanent UNI burn. The prospective test from this timestamp is whether RWA-backed financial-capital migration makes Robinhood's regime and UNI's relative leadership more persistent than raw transaction/memecoin activity would predict.
